citation: Ping FWC, et al. Indian J Med Res 2011;133:96
protocol: Treadmill at 70% of VO2max (VO2max 51 +/- 8.3 mL/kg/min) in a 31 C, 70% RH room until exhaustion (about 84 min); blood at 0, 20, 40, 60 min and at exhaustion; placebo trial of a ginseng crossover; bread and water 2 h before, 3 mL/kg cool water during
population: 9 healthy male recreational runners, 25.4 +/- 6.9 y, 57.6 +/- 8.4 kg
note: Four markers at five times in one table; hot-humid environment shifts the response; the table headers label the second column caffeine though the text says ginseng (read placebo rows only).
